{{Top|leg}}
The '''Twelve Mounts''' were a series of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] surrounding [[Castle Pradeux]] and the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. Each named for a great [[Space warfare/Legends|naval battle]], the Twelve Mounts dwarfed Castle Pradeux. Deep within the mountain range was the [[Naval Crypt]], where the body of the "Father of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]" [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]] was entombed. The Incline of the Twelve Mounts was dotted with monuments and historical artifacts. Below the range was [[Prefsbelt Green]].
